description: This PHP class defines the JobTitle entity for a Doctrine ORM-based application. It models a job title with attributes such as id, name, description, note, deletion status, and related attachments and employees. The class includes ORM mapping annotations, constants, getter and setter methods, and a constructor initializing the employee collection.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: Entity class representing a job title within the HRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_job_title' database table. It manages attributes like ID, title, description, notes, deletion status, and relationships to attachments and employees, along with associated ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the JobTitle instance.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the JobTitle instance.

methods.name: getJobTitleName
methods.description: Retrieves the name/title of the job.

methods.name: setJobTitleName
methods.description: Sets the name/title of the job.

methods.name: getJobDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the job, if any.

methods.name: setJobDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the job.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves any additional note related to the job title.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with the job title.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks whether the job title is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deletion status of the job title.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the associated job specification attachment, if any.

methods.name: setJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Associates a job specification attachment with this job title.
